# Garrab (جرّاب)

> Garrab is an AI virtual try-on service for Egyptian online brands. A shopper uploads one photo and sees the brand's clothing on themselves, or a home décor piece (lamp, rug, cushion, art, mirror) placed in their own room, before they buy. It works on Shopify, WooCommerce and any website, or as a link in an Instagram bio, stories and WhatsApp. Arabic and English. Free 14-day pilot.

Website: https://garrabb.com/ (Arabic: https://garrabb.com/ar)
Start a free pilot: https://app.garrabb.com/start
Contact: WhatsApp +20 100 911 0001
Company: Garrab is powered by Infinisync by Arotech (https://www.theinfinisync.com)

## Who it's for
- Egyptian fashion brands selling online: abayas, dresses, modest wear, jackets, accessories.
- Egyptian home décor brands: lamps, rugs, cushions, wall art, mirrors, furniture.
- Brands with a website (Shopify, WooCommerce, other) and brands that sell only on Instagram or WhatsApp.

## How it works
1. Garrab reads the brand's products from its website, or the brand uploads product photos (many at once).
2. Garrab tests each product on stock models (fashion) or in stock rooms (home décor); the brand approves which products go live.
3. Shoppers tap "Try it on" under Add to cart (website) or open the brand's Garrab link (Instagram/WhatsApp), upload a photo, and get an AI preview in about 20 seconds.

## Features
- Try-on of clothing on the shopper's own photo; room preview for home décor.
- "Try it on" button that matches the brand's own Add to cart button; one line of code, installed by Garrab.
- Try-on link and brand page for Instagram bios, stories and WhatsApp.
- The brand's logo and colours on every try-on page.
- Brand approves every product before shoppers can try it.
- AI size finder in Arabic and English (Growth plan).
- Results for the brand: shoppers, views, try-ons, previews, Buy taps, per product and per period.
- Arabic (right to left) and English shopper pages.
- Privacy: the shopper's photo is used only to create the preview, is not stored by Garrab, and location data is removed before upload.
- Previews are AI images: a close guide, not an exact photo.

## Pricing (Egyptian pounds)
- Free pilot: 14 days, 300 previews, all products, no card, no setup fee.
- Starter: 5,000 EGP per month, 250 previews.
- Growth: 8,500 EGP per month, 600 previews and the size finder.
- Extra previews: 800 EGP per 100.
- One-off setup fee of 1,500 EGP only when continuing on a paid plan (waived for founding brands).
- Payment by InstaPay or bank transfer.

## Common questions
- Does it work with Shopify? Yes. Also WooCommerce, any website, and Instagram-only shops.
- Does it work for home décor? Yes: the item is placed in a photo of the shopper's own room.
- Is it in Arabic? Yes, Arabic and English.
- How long does setup take? Usually the same day; the try-on link works as soon as one product is approved.
